data.gender_notes: Alipio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Alipius'. Meaning 'noble, handsome' or 'dear to the gods'. A popular name among early Christians. The name Alipio carries the meaning “Noble, Handsome” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alipio usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, handsome and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alipio total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
